evidence.title: Ramsar Sites Information Service · L’Albufera (454)
evidence.notes: Official GIS boundary. Approximate projected area is a sanity check, not a new legal site area.

evidence.title: Ramsar Sites Information Service · Srebarna (64)
evidence.notes: Official GIS boundary. The polygon indicates protected-site extent only.
evidence.source_validity: Too few points in geometry component[27.06779725 44.08895151]
evidence.credit: Convention on Wetlands, Ramsar Sites Information Service; Bulgaria.

evidence.title: Copernicus EMSR773 · AOI01 Delineation v1 observed flood
evidence.notes: Published flooded-area features intersected with official Albufera boundary. This is a satellite-derived mapping product with its own imagery dates and coverage.
evidence.clip: Exact intersection with official RSIS site 454 polygon. Display geometry uses 20 m topology-preserving simplification; export retains clipped feature geometries.
evidence.authoritative_for: Published mapped flood extent for the CEMS product observation intervals
evidence.credit: Contains modified Copernicus Service information 2024. Copernicus Emergency Management Service (© 2024 European Union), EMSR773 Valencia Province (AOI01), Delineation v1.

evidence.title: Trinidad and Tobago Institute of Marine Affairs · Gulfstream field response
evidence.notes: Government marine institute reports 7 February 2024 Cove Bay incident and visits to affected shoreline. The explorer rectangle is a study area.

evidence.title: ESA · Gulfstream Sentinel‑1 observation on 14 February 2024
evidence.notes: ESA identifies a Sentinel‑1 observation at 22:18 UTC. It documents the event region and does not supply a slick-extent polygon for this explorer.

evidence.title: ESA · Sentinel‑1 observations of October 2024 Albufera flooding
evidence.notes: ESA identifies Sentinel‑1 dates 19 and 31 October 2024. Its comparison covers a wider area and is independent of the explorer RTC availability check.

evidence.title: CLMS 100 m monthly water-bodies product
evidence.notes: Potential monthly inland water-extent record from 2020 onward. No local series was calculated for this collection.
